name: world-view-1600
js: localStorage.removeItem("dress-up-world-view"); worldViewHidden = false; state.music.mute = true; state.world = clone(DEFAULTS.world); worldChoose(state.background.kind); worldEnter("3,3", null, false); state.background.things = [{ kind: "rock", x: -120, z: 380, seed: 7, size: 100, tone: "#a8634a" }, { kind: "tree", x: 160, z: 340, seed: 9, size: 100 }]; changed(); tab = TABS.findIndex(t => t[1] === "world"); showTab(); setWorldBig(true); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 900)); const side = document.querySelector(".side"), v = document.querySelector(".world-view").getBoundingClientRect(), p = document.getElementById("pic").getBoundingClientRect(); window.__report = { view: [v.left, v.top, v.width, v.height].map(Math.round), pic: [p.left, p.top, p.width, p.height].map(Math.round), scrollTop: side.scrollTop, scrollable: side.scrollHeight - side.clientHeight, inView: !!document.getElementById("pic").closest(".world-view-pic") };
